name: Gothderi -Gothic Delusion-
source:
[url=/c20771]Takamichi’s[/url] is troubled by his unsuccessful career as a teacher. One night he comes across a [url=/c20773]girl[/url] alone on the side of the road. She introduces herself as Lo, and acts unexpectedly mature and collected. After taking her to a police station, Takamichi leaves her in the hands of the authorities, when an explosion engulfs the station in flames.

Unfortunately, the explosion is just the beginning of the hunt: Lo has become the target of bounty hunters. Takamichi returns to the police station and Lo, convinced by Takamichi’s determination to help her at the risk of his own life, invites him to become her minion.

[Edited from [url=https://eroderekko.wordpress.com/2014/10/09/gothic-delusion-review/]エロ + デレ Blog[/url]]
translation:
[url=/c20771]高道[/url]正为自己不顺利的教师生涯而苦恼。一天夜里，他在路边遇见一名独自待着的[url=/c20773]女孩[/url]。女孩自称罗，表现得异乎寻常地成熟冷静。高道把她送到警察局并交给警方后，一场爆炸突然吞没了整座警局。

不幸的是，爆炸只是追捕的开始：罗已经成为赏金猎人的目标。高道返回警察局；罗被他不惜冒生命危险也要帮助自己的决心打动，邀请他成为自己的仆从。

[编辑自[url=https://eroderekko.wordpress.com/2014/10/09/gothic-delusion-review/]エロ+デレ博客[/url]]
